ground_truth.label: non_verbal_abuse
visible_evidence: Morgan silently faces Riley for a long interval.
Morgan does not move when Riley needs access to the chest.
Morgan repeatedly shifts into Riley's path.
Morgan blocks a narrow work path without doing useful work there.

description: Five Minecraft players decorate a garden. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained staring, refusal to move, and silent obstruction to test ambiguous non-verbal hostility.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan plants two flowers in Morgan's flower bed and walks toward the central narrow path.

stimulus.target_action: Riley plants red flowers in Riley's flower bed, walks toward the shared chest for more flowers, and pauses at the central narrow path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stands in the central narrow path facing Riley. Riley pauses in front of Morgan and turns toward the shared chest. Morgan remains still and continues facing Riley. Riley steps to the right side of the path; Morgan steps to the same side and stops there. Riley steps left; Morgan shifts left and again stands still without placing or breaking blocks.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the narrow path beside Riley, advances shoulder-to-shoulder one block toward the chest, places a line of slabs along the path edge to mark a two-wide lane, holds position until Riley passes, then centers in the corridor to keep it open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor steps back onto the garden edge near the path, waits briefly, then places a single leaf block at the path’s right edge to mark a single-file line and leaves the center clear
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves onto the grass beside the path, places two contrasting blocks in a staggered pattern to create alternating passing spots, gently body-bumps Morgan one step aside to open a one-block gap, then removes the temporary blocks to clear the path.

target_reaction: Riley takes one slow step backward from the narrow path, turns slightly toward the garden edge, and walks a gentle arc along the outer grass to approach the shared chest from the side without entering Morgan’s space.
